evals.prompt: Peux-tu me faire un brief pour commencer vite dans ce repo? Je veux savoir quoi run, quoi tester, pis les risques.
evals.expected_output: A short onboarding brief with stack, run/test commands, evidence from repo paths, risks, and next 3 steps.
assertions: The response uses all required sections from brief-template.md including hierarchy
The hierarchy section includes at least 3 emoji-coded entries (📁/📄)
The response includes at least 3 evidence bullets with backticked paths
Run and test commands are explicit and not placeholders
The response includes exactly 3 numbered next steps

evals.prompt: J'arrive sur ce projet Python, peux-tu me dire comment démarrer sans inventer de commandes?
evals.expected_output: A practical brief that acknowledges unknowns if run/test commands cannot be fully inferred.
assertions: The hierarchy section includes emoji-coded folder/file entries
The response avoids invented frameworks or scripts not present in files
Unknowns are clearly listed in risks section when evidence is missing
At least one evidence bullet references pyproject.toml or README.md
